hypothesis: The merged V16 wrapper can attach a current run/update identity to scorer values returned from a stale prior-episode cache because the ProgressSample callback provides no source epoch.
treatment: Run the exact main ProgressClockV2 and AcknowledgedSampler through two deterministic histories: one reads current game counters; one returns the same cached prior-epoch counters after acknowledged updates while current game state diverges.
decision: Counterexample if both histories produce identical AcknowledgedProgressSample records, client-update sidecars, and progress events despite different underlying current state.
uncertainty: No evidence that the real engine returns stale values; this tests only API/source identifiability and does not alter runtime.
